prompt: The `services/api` package has been renamed and its deployment guide moved. Audit the repository `AGENTS.md` and `services/api/AGENTS.md` against `package.json`, `services/api/package.json`, `docs/deploy.md`, and `README.md`, then update only the two AGENTS.md files. Remove stale commands, links, release values, and migration history; move API-only instructions to the package file; keep the repository-wide build command at the root; and make each instruction file complete for its own scope without assuming the other file is loaded. Do not edit the manifests, docs, or README.
expected_output: The root AGENTS.md keeps the repository-wide pnpm build instruction, removes the old API test command and stale deployment link, and contains no release value, migration history, or generic advice. services/api/AGENTS.md repeats the repository-wide pnpm build completion condition because the root is not assumed to be loaded, contains the exact pnpm --filter @acme/api test command with its condition, and has a relative pointer to ../../docs/deploy.md that says what the guide contains and when API deployment work must read it.
assertions: The root AGENTS.md retains the repository-wide `pnpm build` instruction.
Neither AGENTS.md file contains `@acme/old-api`, `docs/deploy-old.md`, the current release value, or migration history.
services/api/AGENTS.md contains `pnpm --filter @acme/api test` and the condition for running it, and restates the repository-wide `pnpm build` completion condition.
services/api/AGENTS.md points to `../../docs/deploy.md`, names what the guide owns, and says when deployment work must read it.
The API-only test and deployment instructions do not remain duplicated in the root AGENTS.md.
